title: Eusebian canon tables
attribution: Transcribed from the public-domain SWORD module Eusebian_num, version 1.1 (2013-01-30), whose conf file states 'DistributionLicense=Public Domain'. The canon tables themselves were composed by Eusebius of Caesarea about AD 340; this file contains only their section numbers, canon assignments, verse ranges and cross-references, with no modern commentary.
note: Tables I-X, with the associated sections in the other Gospels. A section's own number is kept in its id (gospel.section); the table field is the canon it belongs to.
rights: Public domain. The ancient tables carry no copyright; the modern transcription is released as Public Domain by its publisher, CrossWire. No known restrictions.
